# smplkit_service (Data Source)

Read a smplkit service by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "smplkit_service" "user_service" {
  id = "user_service"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The service key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 last-modified timestamp.
